meta.name: Folkbench Switch Desktop
meta.description: Compact, route-comparison desktop design for Folkbench Switch. System UI typography, a light lilac-gray or near-black canvas, quiet static grid, stepped surfaces, and restrained purple signals. Only sign-in uses continuous product lanes.
source_references: Folkbench Switch accepted line-comparison interaction and theme review dated 2026-10-06
Folkbench Switch desktop assistant decisions ADR 0013 and ADR 0020

primary.role: Primary light-theme ink, headings, and strong text

secondary.role: Default light-theme application canvas behind grouped lists

accent.role: Sparse action and focus signal; dark mode uses #A799FF.

neutral.usage: Low-chroma gray canvas, white or stepped near-black surfaces, graphite text, muted metadata, and one-pixel hairlines

color.contrast_strategy: Theme-resolved semantic tokens across all pages, menus, charts, and overlays. Status uses a numeric or textual label as well as color.

font_families.heading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: UI type is the operating-system interface face: San Francisco and PingFang SC on macOS, Segoe UI and Microsoft YaHei UI on Windows. Do not insert Inter, Noto Sans SC, or SF-only weights such as 590. ui-monospace is reserved for URLs, versions, amounts, request identifiers, config diffs, and system labels.

spacing.content_density: Compact controls and tables inside comfortably separated product sections
spacing.section_rhythm: 16-28px component gaps, 24-40px feature groups, and 32-56px page sections depending on window width

layout.grid_system: Native title bar, compact 64px top navigation, home tool selector, 60/40 current-route and local-usage highlights, then a bounded comparison scroll region
layout.columns: Home highlights: 60/40 current route and 7-day local curve at 228px tall. At 850px+ width and 650px+ height home is window-bounded, with a single comparison scroll region. Narrow or short windows retain full page scrolling.
layout.alignment_tendency: Left-aligned task content; navigation remains compact and never consumes a sidebar column.

shape.border_usage: One-pixel semantic boundaries for tables, panels, menus, and the compact header.
shape.divider_style: Stable table rows and section gaps; no nested decorative rails.

elevation.shadow_style: Very soft, low-opacity product elevation; public onboarding remains visually flat
elevation.depth_cues: Stepped surfaces, explicit borders, restrained shadow, active rails, and popover separation

iconography.style: Monoline technical icons with consistent optical boxes

duration_scale.ambient: 54s upper and 68s lower loop, sign-in showcase only

motion.entrance_pattern: Product overlays use short opacity and 4-8px settle; sign-in may place a slow ambient product showcase behind the fixed authentication content
motion.exit_pattern: Faster opacity and 2-4px retreat with no bounce
motion.philosophy: Motion explains state change and hierarchy. The only continuous ambient motion is the sign-in product showcase; it remains visually subordinate to authentication and becomes static under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.button_style: 36px standard control, 32px compact text action, semantic primary ink/inverse, and quiet outline or ghost actions
components.input_style: 36px field, 8px radius, semantic input border and focus ring; custom Base UI selector
components.card_style: 14px grouped panel with semantic hairline and opaque stepped surface
components.navigation_pattern: Native title bar with compact top links for My routes, Discover services, Local usage. Settings and account are utilities. Tool selector belongs to home, not discovery.
components.modal_style: Base UI dialog/sheet/menu with theme-resolved opaque popover, scrim, and overlay shadow. No native selector or clipped in-list menu.
components.list_style: The current route is pinned as the comparison baseline. Saved services can switch; published-only routes enter the existing connect flow. More than three backups remain manageable in a dialog.
components.component_notes: Use shadcn base-nova generated from the official registry, Base UI composition APIs, Hugeicons, semantic CSS tokens, and wrapper components for MF-specific workflows.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A routing control room and configuration field manual
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary developer tooling with restrained neo-brutalist rules and modern product ergonomics

visual_language.complexity: Moderate information density with simple surfaces
visual_language.ornamentation: Quiet static masked grid and subtle signal glow. No daily scrolling background.
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Comfortable between feature groups and compact within tables, forms, and configuration plans
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Navigation and page heading establish orientation; primary work panel dominates; status and metadata remain lighter
visual_language.focal_strategy: Current route and alternatives compared before a deliberate manual switch.
visual_language.contrast_level: High for primary actions and readable data; low-to-medium for metadata, disabled state, and dividers
visual_language.texture_usage: Static theme-resolved grid across the product canvas; continuous product lanes are sign-in-only.

composition.hierarchy_method: Compact navigation, tool selector, side-by-side current service and personal usage, then internally scrolling route comparison.
composition.balance_type: Current-route and local-use highlights balanced above a full-width comparison list
composition.flow_direction: Left-to-right orientation and top-to-bottom task completion
composition.grouping_strategy: Hairline frames, section headers, compact gaps, and explicit transactional stages
composition.negative_space_role: Separates decisions and risk boundaries without making the product feel sparse

imagery.photo_treatment: No stock photography in the application
imagery.illustration_style: Monochrome or graphite technical diagrams with one Folkbench blurple signal
imagery.graphic_elements: Route lines, numbered stages, config diff markers, status dots, system bars, and sparse orthogonal grid
imagery.pattern_usage: 68px static product grid fading below 36rem; sign-in retains its masked-grid treatment.
imagery.image_shape: 4-8px framed diagrams and screenshots aligned to the application grid

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Small surface or border shift; selected tool segment fills white; no large scale transforms
interaction_feel.transition_personality: Snappy and tool-like with soft deceleration
interaction_feel.loading_style: Stable geometry with restrained skeleton blocks; no perpetual shimmer in reduced-motion mode
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Low to moderate and concentrated around state changes

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Direct verbs such as Connect, Inspect, Preview changes, Apply, Verify, and Restore
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain why the state is empty, what is safe to do next, and offer one primary action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: State what failed, what was changed or not changed, whether retry is safe, and the next recovery action

overview.fallback_strategy: Static fully readable UI; disable ambient and entrance motion under prefers-reduced-motion
overview.primary_technology: CSS transitions, transform-only motion, and static SVG

background_effects.type: contextual masked grid with a sign-in product showcase
background_effects.description: Daily screens share a stationary, low-contrast masked grid. Only the sign-in page runs two ambient product-fragment lanes.
background_effects.technology: CSS linear-gradient, mask-image, semantic HTML, and transform-only marquee tracks

params.speed: static grid; 54s upper and 68s lower right-to-left showcase loops
params.interaction: no on-screen motion control; hidden below 700px and static under prefers-reduced-motion

particle_systems.description: Particles conflict with the product's stable configuration focus.

3d_elements.description: No 3D elements are part of the desktop product foundation.

shader_effects.description: Shaders add no value to account or configuration workflows.

scroll_morphing.description: Application geometry remains stable while the user reviews sensitive changes.

text_effects.description: Text remains static, selectable, and optimized for scanning.

cursor_effects.description: Use native pointer and text cursors with explicit focus-visible states.

image_effects.description: Diagrams and screenshots use neutral frames, one-pixel borders, and no distortion.
image_effects.technology: CSS and static SVG or raster assets

params.filter_pipeline: none or grayscale for explanatory diagrams

canvas_drawings.description: Static CSS and SVG cover the initial product visualization needs.

svg_animations.description: Icons remain static; enclosing controls may use CSS opacity or translation.

visual_effects.composite_notes: ADR 0020 supersedes the old grouped-list console geometry and color pair. All screens use the same semantic light/dark palette, with 8px controls, 14px grouped panels, compact top navigation, a 70rem content cap, and a quiet static grid. Only sign-in may show continuously moving redacted product cards. Reduced motion remains mandatory. Keys, switch transactions, login behavior, and published data stay in their existing owners.
